test_suites.description: Baseline evaluation of each of the seven languages independently without code-switching.

scenarios.title: Hindi — Water Request
scenarios.prompt_text: मुझे एक गिलास पानी चाहिए, बहुत प्यास लगी है।
scenarios.phonetic_guide: Mujhe ek gilaas paani chahiye, bahut pyaas lagi hai.
scenarios.english_translation: I need a glass of water, I am very thirsty.

scenarios.title: Marathi — Fatigue Report
scenarios.prompt_text: मला आज खूप थकवा जाणवत आहे, विश्रांती हवी आहे.
scenarios.phonetic_guide: Mala aaj khoop thakva jaanvat aahe, vishraanti havi aahe.
scenarios.english_translation: I am feeling very tired today, I need some rest.

scenarios.title: English — Assistance Request
scenarios.prompt_text: Could you please help me stand up from this chair?
scenarios.phonetic_guide: Could you please help me stand up from this chair?
scenarios.english_translation: Could you please help me stand up from this chair?

scenarios.title: Tamil — Water Request
scenarios.prompt_text: எனக்கு தாகமாக இருக்கிறது, தயவுசெய்து தண்ணீர் தாருங்கள்.
scenarios.phonetic_guide: Enakku thaagamaaga irukkiradhu, thayavuseidhu thanneer thaarungal.
scenarios.english_translation: I am feeling thirsty, please give me water.

scenarios.title: Telugu — Fatigue Report
scenarios.prompt_text: నాకు చాలా అలసటగా ఉంది, కూర్చోవాలి.
scenarios.phonetic_guide: Naaku chaalaa alasatagaa undi, koorchovaali.
scenarios.english_translation: I am very tired, I need to sit down.

scenarios.title: Kannada — Water Request
scenarios.prompt_text: ನನಗೆ ಬಾಯಾರಿಕೆಯಾಗಿದೆ, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ನೀರು ಕೊಡಿ.
scenarios.phonetic_guide: Nanage baayaarikeyagide, dayavittu neeru kodi.
scenarios.english_translation: I am thirsty, please give me water.

scenarios.title: Malayalam — Water Request
scenarios.prompt_text: എനിക്ക് ദാഹിക്കുന്നു, കുറച്ച് വെള്ളം തരുമോ?
scenarios.phonetic_guide: Enikku daahikkunnu, kurachu vellam tharumo?
scenarios.english_translation: I am thirsty, can you give me some water?

test_suites.description: Natural speech evaluation switching between all seven languages (Hindi, Marathi, English, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam).

scenarios.title: Seven-Language Continuous Utterance
scenarios.prompt_text: Suno ASHA (HI), mala khup thakva ahe (MR), I need water (EN), thanneer kidaikkuma (TA), aakali ga ledu (TE), neeru kodi (KN), enikku vishramam venam (ML).
scenarios.phonetic_guide: Suno ASHA, mala khup thakva ahe, I need water, thanneer kidaikkuma, aakali ga ledu, neeru kodi, enikku vishramam venam.
scenarios.english_translation: Listen ASHA, I am very tired, I need water, can I get water, I am not hungry, give water, I need rest.

scenarios.title: Seven-Language Multi-Turn Dialogue (Turn 1)
scenarios.prompt_text: ASHA, mujhe thoda paani chahiye, please bring it.
scenarios.phonetic_guide: ASHA, mujhe thoda paani chahiye, please bring it.
scenarios.english_translation: ASHA, I need some water, please bring it.

scenarios.title: Seven-Language Multi-Turn Dialogue (Turn 2 - Followup)
scenarios.prompt_text: Aani mala chalayla nako (MR), illai vendaam (TA), vaddu (TE), beda (KN), venda (ML).
scenarios.phonetic_guide: Aani mala chalayla nako, illai vendaam, vaddu, beda, venda.
scenarios.english_translation: And I don't want to walk (MR), no don't want (TA), don't want (TE), don't want (KN), don't want (ML).

test_suites.description: Evaluation of hesitation, self-correction, false starts, repetitions, colloquialisms, and cognitive speech patterns.

scenarios.title: Hesitation & Pauses
scenarios.prompt_text: Um... main... kya bol raha tha... I think... paani chahiye mujhe.
scenarios.phonetic_guide: Um... main... kya bol raha tha... I think... paani chahiye mujhe.
scenarios.english_translation: Um... I... what was I saying... I think... I need water.

scenarios.title: Word Repetition (Perseveration)
scenarios.prompt_text: Paani paani... mala paani... paani dya na.
scenarios.phonetic_guide: Paani paani... mala paani... paani dya na.
scenarios.english_translation: Water water... to me water... please give water.

scenarios.title: Mid-Sentence Self-Correction
scenarios.prompt_text: Mujhe walk par jana hai... nahi nahi, I am too tired, let me sit.
scenarios.phonetic_guide: Mujhe walk par jana hai... nahi nahi, I am too tired, let me sit.
scenarios.english_translation: I want to go for a walk... no no, I am too tired, let me sit.

scenarios.title: Incomplete Trailing Sentence
scenarios.prompt_text: I was thinking that maybe... well, you know...
scenarios.phonetic_guide: I was thinking that maybe... well, you know...
scenarios.english_translation: I was thinking that maybe... well, you know...

scenarios.title: Medication Uncertainty Recollection
scenarios.prompt_text: Did I take my yellow tablet today, or did I take it kal?
scenarios.phonetic_guide: Did I take my yellow tablet today, or did I take it kal?
scenarios.english_translation: Did I take my yellow tablet today, or did I take it yesterday?
